title: Concept: Weak response control (HSTS without includeSubDomains)
description: Strict-Transport-Security does not cover subdomains. Only the exact host is pinned to HTTPS, so any subdomain that still answers over plaintext can be used to intercept or set cookies that the parent domain trusts, and the parent policy will not upgrade the browser on that host.
risk: Cleartext subdomain usable to intercept or set parent-domain cookies; MEDIUM severity because exploitation needs a live plaintext subdomain.
